audio_tags.rule: Build a deliberate emotional arc with clear highs, quiet lows, natural shifts in intensity, selective laughter for genuine jokes, and neutral beats for contrast. Tags must never appear in visible text.
audio_tags.opening_rule: Choose the first scene's delivery from the script's mood and message. It may begin with laughter, low voice, thoughtful reflection, sarcasm, curiosity, excitement, drama, mischievousness, a whisper, or neutral delivery. Never default every script to one opening tone.

policy.new_generation_minimum: Equal or exceed the approved Maybe the Knob Isn't Broken performance for realism, emotional range, pacing, contrast, selective humor, and mood-appropriate opening delivery.
policy.acceptable_replacement: Only a demonstrably more natural, higher-fidelity recording approved by James.
policy.final_mastering: Preserve the supplied performance and timing. Limit processing to transparent cleanup, loudness control, and high-quality delivery encoding.
